decides.ask: Does this file use the data under analysis to make a business decision?
decides.yes: The data affects filtering, validation, matching, assignment, uniqueness, or a reference check before a write.
decides.no: The data is only declared, selected, rendered, transported, or absent.

scopes_access.ask: Does this file use the data under analysis to limit what a user may see or do?
scopes_access.yes: A role, user, or data scope depends on this data.
scopes_access.no: No access or visibility rule depends on this data.

stores_copy.ask: Does this file write a copy of the data under analysis elsewhere?
stores_copy.yes: It persists the value in another record, snapshot, summary, cache, or export.
stores_copy.no: It does not persist the value outside its owning record.

display_only.ask: Is the data under analysis used here purely for display or transport?
display_only.yes: It is only a field, label, option, or pass-through value.
display_only.no: It is used in logic, or is absent.
